items: Dabna (compression): solid ke zarraat qareeb qareeb bhare hain aur gas ke bar-aks qareeb nahi aa sakte. Metallic solids mein atoms kurrawi taur par mutawazan hain aur hexagonal aur cubic close-packed banawaton mein bharte hain jin mein zarraat chhoote hain magar, kurre hone ki wajah se, 74 feesad se zyada jagah nahi bhar sakte; solids ka dabna mumkin nahi.

Phailna (expansion): phailao zarraat ke darmiyan jagah barhata hai, magar solids mein kashish ki forces itni mazboot hain ke darja hararat barhne se un ki nisbati jagahein mushkil se mutasir hoti hain; zarraat apni ausat jagahon ke gird larazte hain aur hajm mushkil se barhta hai. Khatti aur mukaab phailao ke coefficients hain magar liquids aur gases ke muqable mein na-hone ke barabar.
Zarraat ki harkat: solid ke zarraat na muntaqili (translatory) harkat karte hain na ghoomne wali; woh sirf apni ausat jagahon ke gird larazte hain, zyada darja hararat par zyada shiddat se.
Zarraat ke darmiyan jagah: mazboot forces ki wajah se jagahein liquids se kahin kam hain, to solids zyada tar sakht hain, oonche melting points aur zyada istehkam ke saath.
Zarraat ke darmiyan forces: zarraat ionic, covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces se jure hain, jo unhen jagah par band rakhne aur sirf larazne dene ke liye kaafi mazboot hain.
Kinetic energy: kyunke solid ke zarraat sirf larazti harkat rakhte hain, solid ki wahid kinetic energy vibrational kinetic energy hai.

rows: Sab se kam (kurre zyada se zyada 74 feesad bharte hain)

blocks.prompt: Solids ka dabna aur phailna bohat kam kyun hai, aur un ke zarraat translatory harkat kyun nahi karte?
blocks.explanation: Zarraat pehle hi chhoo rahe hain, to nichorne ke liye koi khali jagah nahi, aur kashish ki forces itni mazboot hain ke garam karne se zarraat jagah badle baghair sirf thora zyada larazte hain. Wahi mazboot forces har zarre ko banawat mein us ki jagah band rakhti hain, to woh solid mein safar nahi kar sakta; sirf apni ausat jagah ke gird laraz sakta hai.

items: Solids: koi dabna nahi (qareeb bharai, kurre zyada se zyada 74 feesad bharte hain), na-hone ke barabar phailao, sirf larazna (na muntaqili na ghoomna), zarraat ke darmiyan sab se kam jagah, ionic, covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces se jure, sirf vibrational kinetic energy.
